caption:
Global Metadata: A serene, peaceful wordless hum piece, 72 BPM, C major, an ambient calm meditative instrumental. Emotional arc: wholly tranquil and restful from start to finish, a sense of quiet morning light, gentle exhale, soft well-being. Production: airy, spacious, warm soft reverb, gentle dynamics.

Vocal Details: A single voice only, an adult female mezzo-soprano humming wordlessly the whole time, a warm, smooth, breathy 'mm' and 'aah', calm and soothing, like a lullaby. Never harsh, never loud. The hum stays tender and relaxed.

Arrangement: Intro, soft ambient piano over a distant warm string pad, very hush. Body, the female hum floats a gentle single line over sparse soft piano and a faint sustained cello, unhurried and restful. Ending, the hum and piano fade to a quiet, open calm.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Soft piano, warm pad, hush

[Body]
mm... mm... aah... mm...
aah... mm... aah...

[End]
piano and hum fade into calm
